<!-- Keep examples specific to Serializer and remove private application details. -->

## Problem or use case

Describe what you are trying to accomplish and the limitation you encountered.
Which output languages, protocols, or platforms are involved?

## Proposed behavior

Explain the desired result. Include a small schema, API, command-line, or output
example if it helps. Clearly label proposed syntax or APIs as proposals.

## Alternatives

Describe existing approaches or workarounds and why they are insufficient.

## Compatibility and scope

Describe any expected impact on existing schemas, public APIs, wire formats,
generated code, resource limits, or performance. It is fine to say this is unknown.

## Additional context

Link related issues or documentation and explain how the improvement could be
verified.
